_comment: PER-BOT config — install at ~/.codex-channel-octo/<id>/config.json (the <id> must match an entry in the global config's `bots` list; for a single bot use id 'default'). This file is the highest-priority layer: it overrides both the inline bots[] entry and the global shared fields. It holds the bot's REQUIRED botToken. The bot's directories are derived automatically as siblings of this file: ./data, ./workspace, ./codex-home. Drop a ./SOUL.md next to this file to give the bot a personality (it overrides sdk.systemPrompt).
_comment_privateMemory: Opt-in MEMORY.md beside SOUL.md, loaded only for the current registration owner's DMs. Groups/topics/other DMs receive none. Bounded background data, never shared AGENTS.md. Does not restrict filesystem tools under danger-full-access.
_comment_cards: Empty cards inherits all global/inline fields for THIS Bot. Explicit fields override individually. Defaults: disable=false (boolean local kill switch only), eventTransport=off (off|short|long), reasoningSummary=off (off|on|stream). No setting grants server policy, routing authority, topology or reasoning authorization. Unknown card keys/wrong types fail startup. Same-ID edits require restart or explicit remove/re-add for a new snapshot.
_comment_overrides: Any of these optional fields override the global config for THIS bot only:
_comment_apiUrl: apiUrl — override the Octo API base for this bot.

sdk._comment_private_diagnostics_details: Requires privateDiagnostics=true too; bounded metadata only, no arbitrary text; local POSIX filesystem safety flags required.
sdk._comment_private_diagnostics: Optional override: privateDiagnostics=true records bounded local failure metadata and message fingerprints; defaults off. No raw messages or tool output.
sdk._comment_model: Override the model for this bot, e.g. 'gpt-5.5'. Omit to use the codex provider default.
sdk._comment_systemPrompt: Inline personality string. A ./SOUL.md file next to this config overrides it. Written to the session AGENTS.md together with the security prefix.
sdk._comment_codex_home: Per-bot CODEX_HOME (codex auth/config/sessions root). Defaults to ./codex-home (isolated — IM content stays out of your personal ~/.codex; authenticate it via `codex login` with CODEX_HOME set, or set sdk.codexApiKey). OPT-IN SHARING: set this to your personal ~/.codex to let IM threads be resumed from your own terminal — note IM content then lands in your personal codex sessions.
sdk._comment_env: Extra env injected into the codex subprocess (on top of CODEX_HOME), e.g. provider routing vars.
